answer: To blunt Sybil floods, each new agent must lock a refundable bond that scales with recent network stake: spinning up a comet of sockpuppet peers then burns real capital, not free signups. Bonds stay frozen through a velvet cooling window until peers attest useful work; coordinated spam triggers slash. The economic canyon between one honest identity and a thousand fakes is bond times attack size, so attackers pay linear cost while honest actors pay once.
